Meta.title: See your beach on Sunbnb
Meta.description: Enter your beach and number of sunbeds and see them on the map, ready for guests to book online.

Hero.title: Let guests book your sunbeds before they reach the sand
Hero.subtitle: Guests pick their exact sunbed on a map and pay by card. Find your beach and see it working there, in under a minute.

noshow.title: Front-row sunbeds, paid before guests arrive
noshow.subtitle: Guests choose their exact sunbed on a map and pay online. See it on your own beach — free, in under a minute.

cash.title: Stop handling cash on the sand
cash.subtitle: Guests pay by card when they book their sunbed or order drinks to it. See how it looks on your own beach.

online.title: Let tourists book your sunbeds online
online.subtitle: Put your exact sunbeds on a map guests can book from their phone. See it on your own beach now.

queue.title: No more queues at the sunbed kiosk
queue.subtitle: Guests arrive with a QR pass and walk straight to their sunbed. See it on your own beach.

Facts.f1: They pick a sunbed on your map, pay online and get a booking pass with a QR code on their phone.
Facts.f2Title: Food and drinks from the sunbed
Facts.f2: Guests scan a QR code at their sunbed to order and pay from their phone.
Facts.f3: Runs in the browser on the phones, tablets and laptops you already have.

Beach.notFound: We couldn't find that beach. Please search again.
Beach.mapUnavailable: The map can't be shown right now.

Demo.title: Want this on your beach?
Demo.subtitle: Leave your details and we'll show you Sunbnb set up for {beach}.
Demo.name: Your name
Demo.contactHint: Email or phone — whichever you prefer.
Demo.message: Anything you'd like us to know? (optional)
Demo.consent: I agree that Sunbnb stores these details to contact me about a demo, as described in the <link>privacy notice</link>.
Demo.thanks: Thanks! We'll be in touch soon.
Demo.thanksBody: Your mockup stays saved at this page's link.
Demo.errContact: Please give an email or a phone number.
Demo.errPhone: That phone number doesn't look right.
Demo.errConsent: Please tick the box so we're allowed to contact you.
Demo.errRateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
Demo.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Chat.notice: AI assistant. Your messages are stored and sent to Anthropic to generate replies; if you share an email or phone, we'll contact you about a demo. <link>Privacy</link>
Chat.unavailable: The assistant isn't available right now — you can still request a demo below.
Chat.limit: This chat has reached its limit. Please use the demo form below and we'll get back to you.
Chat.rateLimited: You're sending messages too fast. Please wait a moment.
Chat.fallbackReply: Sorry, I couldn't answer that one. Could you rephrase it, or leave your email or phone and the team will help directly?

Consent.title: Cookies
Consent.body: We use necessary cookies to run this site. With your permission we also use Meta and Google advertising cookies to measure our ads. <link>Privacy notice</link>

Thread.greeting: Hi! Where’s your beach? Type its name, or tell me more, like “Platja de Muro, 80 sunbeds and a bar”.
Thread.nearFound: These are the beaches near you. Is yours one of them?
Thread.noLocation: I couldn’t get your location. Type your beach’s name instead.
Thread.searchDown: Search isn’t answering right now. Try again in a moment.
Thread.noMatch: I couldn’t find that one. Try the beach or town name.
Thread.pickOne: Here’s what I found. Pick yours.
Thread.pickError: That beach couldn’t be loaded. Pick it again or try another.
Thread.flying: Flying to {beach}. I’m reading your shoreline…
Thread.flyingAskRuns: Flying to {beach}. While I read your shoreline: what else do you run?
Thread.countAsk: Here’s your beach, facing the sea. How many sunbeds do you have?
Thread.countHave: Here’s your beach, facing the sea, with {count} sunbeds. Build it?
Thread.rowsLine: {count, plural, one {# sunbed} other {# sunbeds}} in {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
Thread.buildFailed: Your beach couldn’t be saved. Try again in a moment.
Thread.built: {beach} is on Sunbnb. Now be your first guest: tap a green sunbed.
Thread.welcomeBack: Welcome back to {beach}. Be your first guest: tap a green sunbed.
Thread.bedFront: Front row, today. Set your price; this is what guests see.
Thread.bedRow: Row {row}, today. Set your price; this is what guests see.
Thread.payAsk: The guest pays by card. This is a demo, so nothing is charged.
Thread.demoNote: Demo: no payment is taken and nothing is reserved.
Thread.paid: Booked and paid. {label} turned red on your map, so no one else can book it. The guest gets this pass.
Thread.staffAsk: Your guest has arrived. This is your staff’s view: tap {label} to check them in.
Thread.checked: Checked in. Paid before arrival, one tap at the desk.
Thread.liveAsk: Let’s put {beach} on Sunbnb. Leave your details below, or just type your email or phone here.
Thread.thanks: Thanks! The Sunbnb team will be in touch soon. Ask me anything meanwhile.
Thread.agentOff: I can’t answer questions right now, but the demo keeps going.
Thread.ph_count: Number of sunbeds, or ask anything…
Thread.ph_live: Your email or phone, or ask anything…
Thread.countAskManual: Here’s your beach. I couldn’t read the shoreline here, so turn the beds to face the sea with ↺ ↻. How many sunbeds do you have?
Thread.countHaveManual: Here’s your beach with {count} sunbeds. I couldn’t read the shoreline here, so turn them to face the sea with ↺ ↻, then build it.
Thread.moveHint: Tap the map where the sunbeds should go
